notes_for_editor: Build year (1933) and removal (1964) agree across the register and firelookout.com; only the removal wording differs. No source describes what remains at the site or its access status; the 2007 photograph on the register page was not inspected, so nothing is claimed about its contents. The brief's events list had only the FFLOS registration, so the 1933 build, the 1941 and 1945 staffing and the 1964 removal are added. The Oregon Lookouts 'Removed' label has no date. No corrections proposed.
